name: Presentation
description: Ordered slides built from saved views, with camera paths between them, playback and a recorded walkthrough.

catalog.tagline: Saved views as an ordered walkthrough, played or recorded
catalog.about: Once views exist, a design review is mostly sequencing. Order them into slides, give each a dwell time, and the camera flies between them on an eased path. Play it in the meeting, or record it as a video and send that instead of the screen recording somebody makes by hand at the end of every review.
catalog.keywords: presentation slides walkthrough flythrough camera path record video design review demo
does: Build slides from saved views, in any order
Eased camera flight between slides, with per-slide dwell and travel time
Play full screen, or step through with the keyboard
Record the walkthrough to a WebM video
Save the deck as a file the project keeps
